d: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has raised concerns over the US economy's growing dependence on artificial intelligence-linked stocks as Jensen Huang returns to the helm of Nvidia. Mamdani questioned the concentration of wealth among a handful of powerful individuals, warning that workers' pension savings could be vulnerable to volatility in AI-driven markets. Citing a reported $81 billion divorce settlement, he highlighted the scale of wealth inequality and its implications for public welfare. His remarks come as Nvidia shares surged following US President Donald Trump's announcement…
